lineas.texto: These paintings are taller than a door. They were painted in 1907, before anyone called anything abstract art.
lineas.tts: [awed] These paintings are taller than a door. They were painted in 1907... before anyone called anything abstract art.

lineas.texto: The woman who painted them said she didn't paint them alone.
lineas.accion: Emotion: contained awe. He starts already leaning slightly toward the lens, as if he has just seen the paintings with us; his eyebrows rise slowly on 'didn't paint them alone' and a disbelieving smile forms; he ends he holds still with wide eyes, as if he can't believe it. No hands, no body.

direccion.entra: already leaning slightly toward the lens, as if he has just seen the paintings with us
direccion.gesto: his eyebrows rise slowly on 'didn't paint them alone' and a disbelieving smile forms
direccion.sale: he holds still with wide eyes, as if he can't believe it (cut to The Five)

lineas.texto: Five women met every week in Stockholm for séances. They called themselves The Five.
lineas.tts: Five women met every week in Stockholm... for séances. They called themselves... The Five.

lineas.texto: Zoom into the spirals: no sketches underneath. She swore the shapes came all at once.
lineas.accion: Emotion: intense curiosity. He starts from a neutral face, his eyes narrow; he leans in toward the lens as if peering into the canvas on 'zoom into the spirals'; his eyes snap open on 'all at once'; he ends eyes wide, lips slightly parted. No hands, no body.

direccion.entra: from a neutral face, his eyes narrow
direccion.gesto: he leans in toward the lens as if peering into the canvas on 'zoom into the spirals'; his eyes snap open on 'all at once'
direccion.sale: eyes wide, lips slightly parted (cut to her words on the torn strips)

lineas.texto: The pictures were painted directly through me, without any preliminary drawings, and with great force.
lineas.tts: [whispers] The pictures were painted directly through me... without any preliminary drawings... and with great force.

lineas.texto: She showed them to the most famous mystic of her time. He said nobody would understand them for fifty years.
lineas.accion: Emotion: soft indignation on her behalf. He starts eyes low and quiet after her quote, out of respect, then up to the lens; he tilts his head on 'the most famous mystic'; on 'fifty years' he slowly shakes his head once; he ends after the shake he holds a steady, serious look. No hands, no body.

direccion.entra: eyes low and quiet after her quote, out of respect, then up to the lens
direccion.gesto: he tilts his head on 'the most famous mystic'; on 'fifty years' he slowly shakes his head once
direccion.sale: after the shake he holds a steady, serious look (cut to 'she stopped painting')

lineas.texto: She stopped painting for four years. Then she came back and finished the series.
lineas.tts: She stopped painting for four years. [softly] Then she came back... and finished the series.

lineas.texto: Her name was Hilma af Klint. Stockholm, 1862 to 1944.
lineas.tts: Her name was Hilma af Klint. Stockholm... 1862 to 1944.

lineas.texto: Before she died, she asked that this work stay hidden until twenty years after her death.
lineas.accion: Emotion: complicity, a secret. He starts very close to the lens, as if about to whisper; his voice drops; his eyes stay still on 'stay hidden'; one slow blink on 'twenty years'; he ends he stays close and still for a beat. No hands, no body.

direccion.entra: very close to the lens, as if about to whisper
direccion.gesto: his voice drops; his eyes stay still on 'stay hidden'; one slow blink on 'twenty years'
direccion.sale: he stays close and still for a beat (jump cut, punch-in to the last line)

lineas.texto: In 2019, her show became the most visited in the Guggenheim's history. The mystic was wrong. It took a century.
lineas.accion: Emotion: pride and final awe. He starts landing big from the punch-in, a slow proud smile growing on 'most visited'; one eyebrow rises on 'the mystic was wrong'; on 'it took a century' he holds the lens in silence with a small amazed shake of the head; he ends still, looking at us, smiling: the button appears. No hands, no body.
